specification.objective: Supersede v3 proof guarantee and correct imperceptible employee selection: regression executes both complete employee and contrast test files, including global toggle and Enter.

requirements.statement: Distinguish selected employee with an indicator of at least 3:1 contrast against adjacent surfaces without restoring the strong yellow background; preserve high contrast.
Preserve semantics, keyboard focus and activation, light/dark and compact/desktop behavior; keep text contrast at least 4.5:1.
Supersede v3 proof coverage by executing both complete admin contrast and employee widget test files; archive this lock byte-identically.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Real widget selected border contrasts at least 3:1 with selected and adjacent surface across themes and sizes; selection and keyboard semantics work.
Full contrast and employee widget test files including global toggle and Enter execute as regression; text contrast thresholds remain unchanged.
Archived v4 contract is byte-identical to external lock.

invariants.statement: High contrast colors, 4.5:1 text contrast, unrelated surfaces and selection interactions remain unchanged.

forbidden_states.statement: Normal selected employee card restores strong yellow background or weakens high contrast.

inputs.statement: Employee list and profile widgets and global theme.

outputs.statement: Normalized scoped surfaces and regression coverage.

failure_semantics.statement: Widget regression fails on insufficient selected border contrast.
